$comment: Source of truth for story scope and state. Agents may set not_started->active and active<->blocked. Only `pnpm verify US-XX` may set passing and evidence. WIP=1: at most one story is active.

stories.title: Project setup & agent harness
stories.behavior: Fresh clone bootstraps with ./scripts/init.sh; pnpm dev serves /api/health ok; pnpm check, test:int, test:e2e smoke pass; pnpm verify gates story state.

stories.title: Security foundation: encryption, redacted logging, request IDs
stories.behavior: AES-256-GCM secret encryption with versioned format; logger redacts secrets at any depth; sanitized error responses; x-request-id on every response.

stories.title: Sign in with Jira OAuth 2.0 (3LO)
stories.behavior: User signs in via Atlassian OAuth with state validation; tokens stored encrypted and auto-refreshed single-flight; tokens never reach the browser.

stories.title: Sign in with Jira email + API token (fallback)
stories.behavior: User connects with site URL + email + API token validated via /myself; SSRF-safe site URL; same Jira client interface as OAuth.

stories.title: Xray Cloud credentials & JWT exchange
stories.behavior: Xray client ID/secret verified then stored encrypted; JWT cached server-side until near expiry; 401 re-auth and 429 backoff in the GraphQL client.

stories.title: Select Jira/Xray project for the workspace
stories.behavior: User picks a Jira project; numeric project ID stored; Xray access probed; project change blocked while drafts exist.

stories.title: Gherkin Markdown parser & serializer (library)
stories.behavior: Parses .md with gherkin fences or raw Gherkin into features/scenarios; maps scenarios to test case fields; canonical serializer round-trips losslessly; located errors.

stories.title: Pull Xray folder tree into local cache
stories.behavior: Full folder tree pulled transactionally and idempotently; remote deletions reflected; concurrent pulls rejected.

stories.title: Pull test cases with last-synced snapshot
stories.behavior: All project tests pulled with paginated GraphQL into TestCase + exact TestCaseSnapshot with fingerprint; transactional; non-Cucumber tests read-only.

stories.title: Browse the cached Test Repository
stories.behavior: Folder tree + test list with search, filters, deep links, read-only detail and safe rendering; selection can open the editor.

stories.title: Bulk editor grid with local drafts
stories.behavior: Virtualized grid edits summary/labels/status as server-side drafts with autosave, validation, undo; no remote writes; no-op edits remove drafts.

stories.title: Bulk actions across a selection
stories.behavior: Add/remove/rename labels, set status, find & replace (ReDoS-safe) across a selection with preview, single-step undo, drafts only.

stories.title: Gherkin steps editor
stories.behavior: Code editor with Gherkin highlighting, completion, live parser validation, compare-with-Xray, saves Gherkin draft.

stories.title: Import test cases from Markdown
stories.behavior: Upload .md, preview Update/Unchanged/Create/Error per scenario, confirm into drafts and new local tests; never writes to Xray.

stories.title: Export test cases to Markdown
stories.behavior: Export selection/folder/drafted tests as Local or Xray version to canonical .md grouped by folder; export then import is a no-op.

stories.title: Field-level diff engine (library)
stories.behavior: Deterministic field-level diff (summary, label sets, status, Gherkin hunks) with normalization and a data-only sync plan.

stories.title: Review changes before sync
stories.behavior: Review page shows every pending change as a diff, include/exclude and discard per test, confirmation freezes a PENDING SyncBatch.

stories.title: Detect and resolve remote conflicts
stories.behavior: Three-way base/remote/local classification: clean, auto-rebase, field conflict, deleted remotely; resolution UI; pull never destroys drafts.

stories.title: Sync edits of existing tests to Xray/Jira
stories.behavior: Executes a frozen SyncBatch: conflict pre-check, Jira field update, status transition, Xray Gherkin update, re-snapshot; per-item results; idempotent re-run.

stories.title: Create new tests in Xray from imports
stories.behavior: Creates Cucumber tests (and missing folders) for imported scenarios, stores returned keys, prevents duplicates on interrupted creates, offers updated Markdown with @xray tags.

stories.title: Sync history & audit log
stories.behavior: History of sync and import batches with applied diffs, errors, retry-failed flow, filters and idempotent retention cleanup; no secrets stored.

stories.title: End-to-end golden path & release readiness
stories.behavior: Full journey sign-in -> pull -> edit -> import -> conflict -> review -> sync -> export -> re-import passes on a fresh DB; no secret leaks; production container healthy.
